title: Kili GUI
description: A simple resource pack that tweak the GUI of minecraft.
body:
Resource taht tweaks the GUI of the game with the goal of a modern an transparent GUI.
For now it change :
- crosshair / attack indicator
- hotbar
- xp bar and hearths
- craft guide and advancements
- a bit of the menus

You can check the recents update on my [git repository](https://github.com/Kilij0/Kili-GUI)
